title: PQC-Corpus: code to mine, filter and release a dataset of post-quantum cryptography development
description:
Code that builds PQC-Corpus, a dataset of the development history of 179 public GitHub repositories about post-quantum cryptography (PQC), collected on 21–24 September 2026. It mines commits with full patches, issues and pull requests with their discussions and reviews, and repository metadata; filters the commits (114,361 to 47,729) and issues (5,713 to 5,687) with fixed, scripted rules; and writes a checksummed release with Table I and Figures 3–5.

The dataset itself is on Hugging Face: pqc-datasets/pqc-corpus (CC BY 4.0).
